_about: The flag shop's flags (docs/flag-shop.md). Art: tools/assets/gen_shop_flags.py asks Codex for art/<key>.png from `style` + each `prompt`; tools/assets/make_shop_flags.py makes the game's atlases, icons and products from those. `set` = a limited set (Data/Shop.SETS); none = the daily pool.
style: A premium flag for a world-conquest strategy game. Landscape 3:2 image, 1536x1024. The flag fills the whole canvas edge to edge: no border, no pole, no waving cloth, no drop shadow, flat front view. Bold flat vector illustration with thick dark outlines, 4 to 6 flat colours, at most soft two-tone shading. One centred emblem about 70% of the canvas height, on a simple background field (solid, a two-tone split, broad stripes or checks). It must stay readable when shrunk to 36x24 pixels: a big simple silhouette, strong contrast between emblem and field, no fine detail, no thin lines, no small scattered objects. No text, letters or numbers. Not based on any real country's flag or coat of arms, nor any religious, political or military symbol, brand, logo or copyrighted character. Family friendly: no blood or gore.
